summary: The diff implements Iterator.prototype.filter in its own file and follows the spec steps in order. Step 2 throws a TypeError for a non-object this. Step 4 checks IsCallable before GetIteratorDirect and closes the iterator through ops::iterator_close with a TypeError completion. Step 5 calls GetIteratorDirect with ?. Step 6 is a FilterClosure whose resume loop does IteratorStepValue (?), Call(predicate, undefined, value, counter) with IfAbruptCloseIterator, increments the counter with the 2^53 cap, applies ToBoolean and yields the value. Steps 7 to 9 build the helper with the iterated record. The predicate is traced for GC. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no made-up values. The new "Yield" path depends on HelperClosure's default on_return performing IteratorClose on return(); I could not see that trait default, so this is unverified rather than a defect.
